title: Strict German Comparative Advertising Act (UWG § 6)
explanation: German law strictly restricts naming or degrading competitor products without certified independent laboratory testing certificates published simultaneously.
recommendation: Switch creative angle to direct consumer benefit without explicit competitor comparison.

title: Indonesian Ramadan Broadcast & Halal Protocol
explanation: Depicting daytime eating during Ramadan fasting hours is culturally controversial in Indonesia; food content must be framed around Iftar (sunset) or Sahur (pre-dawn) and display MUI Halal certification.
recommendation: Ensure all food imagery is clearly captioned with Iftar timings and Halal verification stamp.

title: US FTC Influencer Endorsement Guides Compliance
explanation: The FTC strictly penalizes deceptive format advertising, paid creator stunts, and unlabelled brand integrations with fines up to $50,120 per violation.
recommendation: Mandate upfront #Ad/#Sponsored visual text disclosures in first 3 seconds of creator video.

title: UK CMA Green Claims Code & ASA Environmental Guidance
explanation: UK Advertising Standards Authority bans broad environmental claims ('sustainable', 'eco-friendly') unless accompanied by clear life-cycle breakdown data in the same asset.
recommendation: Specify precise metric (e.g. '100% recycled bottle plastic, excluding cap') instead of generalized green slogans.

title: Indian Cultural Dietary & Faith Nuance
explanation: Dietary sensitivities regarding vegetarianism and religious symbols require stringent review by local brand counsel to avoid consumer boycott calls.
recommendation: Validate Green Dot vegetarian certification marks and ensure script avoids religious iconography.

title: CONAR Brazilian Self-Regulation Advertising Code
explanation: CONAR enforces strict guidelines on hyper-sexualization and beauty stereotyping in public broadcast and social feeds.
recommendation: Emphasize personal empowerment, sensory indulgence, and diversity over objectifying aesthetics.
